description: Fishers Imports has this exceptionally equipped 2026 BMW X5 xDrive40i Sports Activity Vehicle, finished in sophisticated Skyscraper Grey Metallic over a Black Sensafin interior. This premium luxury SUV combines BMW performance, advanced technology, all-wheel-drive capability, and first-class comfort, making it equally at home on the daily commute or a long-distance road trip.  Power comes from BMWs responsive 3.0L turbocharged inline-six engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time xDrive all-wheel drive. The X5 delivers confident performance while achieving an EPA-estimated 23 MPG city and 27 MPG highway. Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout the X5 with BMW Live Cockpit Pro, navigation, Apple CarPlay®, Android Auto, wireless device charging, Personal eSIM 5G connectivity, and ConnectedDrive services. The Harman/Kardon Surround Sound System delivers premium audio throughout the cabin, while SiriusXM® with 360L provides an extensive selection of entertainment. Remote engine start and Comfort Access add convenience to everyday driving.  Parking and driver assistance technology provide added confidence behind the wheel. Automatic high beams, rain-sensing wipers, heated power-folding mirrors, and adaptive LED lighting further improve visibility and convenience.  The X5 also delivers impressive practicality with a power liftgate, split-folding rear seating, concealed cargo storage, and trailer sway control. Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin designed for daily comfort and practicality. Dual front zone climate control allows driver and passenger to set individual temperature preferences, while the power-adjustable driver seat helps you find your ideal driving position. The split-folding rear seat expands your cargo versatility, and the power liftgate makes loading and unloading convenient regardless of what you're carrying.  Safety features integrated throughout this vehicle demonstrate Toyota's commitment to protecting you and your passengers. The system includes dual front and side impact airbags, an overhead airbag, electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist with ABS, and a Lane Departure Warning System to help you maintain awareness on your drive. The rear parking camera provides visual assistance when backing into parking spaces.  Technology and convenience features work together to enhance your driving experience. Steering wheel mounted audio controls keep your hands on the wheel while adjusting station or volume, the outside temperature display keeps you informed of conditions, and the trip computer tracks your fuel efficiency and driving statistics. Auto High-beam Headlights automatically adjust between low and high beams based on traffic detection.  This RAV4 Hybrid SE represents a practical choice for buyers seeking a capable, efficient vehicle with the reliability Toyota owners trust.
